name: Painesville
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Painesville, OH 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Painesville, Ohio for 2026: free Santa in the Square, Painesville Holiday Lights and the Chardon Christmas Lighting, with dates from city and association sites.
lede: Painesville puts Santa in the square on two December weekends and lines Painesville Square and Main Street with more than 150,000 lights, with Chardon's square lighting a short drive east.
celebrates: The City of Painesville's holiday page lists Holiday Lights on Painesville Square and Main Street from November 20 to January 1, a free Santa in the Square on two December weekends, and Santa's Mailbox beside Santa's house through December 14. Chardon, the Geauga County seat, lights its square on November 28 with live music and a visit from Santa and Mrs. Claus.
lastyear: The city's calendar shows last year's Santa in the Square on Friday, December 5, 2025 at 6 pm. For 2026 the city adds six visit windows over two weekends, December 4 to 6 and December 11 to 13.
facts: Painesville Recreation's Spirit of the Season on November 20 is described by the city as its most popular kids' event of the year, with train rides around the Square, but it has already happened for 2026. The lights are on Ohio's Holiday Lights Trail, and the city names Gartman Model Bakery's gingerbread window at 30 North State Street as a must see.
trains: Painesville Recreation's Spirit of the Season brought train rides around the Square on November 20, which is past. Lake Metroparks Farmpark in Kirtland sets up a North Pole Train Display from the Northern Ohio Garden Railroad Society during its Holiday Ice & Lights Festival on November 27 to 29 and December 18 to 23. The Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad runs its North Pole Adventure from Rockside Station in Independence from November 13 to December 22, 2026, with 5:00 pm and 7:55 pm departures and tickets listed at $60 to $110 per person, according to the railroad.
train_links: The railroad that runs the North Pole Adventure Christmas train from Rockside Station in Independence.
traditions: A free visit with Santa at his house in Painesville Square on two December weekends.
Children can post letters beside Santa's house through December 14, with a return address for Santa's reply.
More than 150,000 lights on Painesville Square and Main Street, nightly to January 1.
Gartman Model Bakery's gingerbread window on North State Street.
Live music, Santa and Mrs. Claus, cider and cookies on Chardon Square.
kidfact: Painesville's Santa has his own mailbox in the square, and the city asks kids to add a return address so Santa can write back.
faq: When can kids see Santa in Painesville?
Santa in the Square runs December 4 to 6 and December 11 to 13, 2026, with Friday evening, Saturday and Sunday windows, and the city says it is free.
Where are the Painesville holiday lights?
On Painesville Square and Main Street, nightly from dusk to dawn, November 20 to January 1.
When is the Chardon Christmas Lighting?
Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 6:30 pm to 8 pm on Chardon Square.
Why is a Chardon event on the Painesville page?
Chardon is a small town with one verified event this season, so it sits with Painesville, the nearest town with its own page.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Painesville for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Christmas Lighting of the Square in Chardon) through January 1 (Painesville Holiday Lights), with Concord Township's tree lighting (December 4), Santa in the Square (December 4) and Fairport Harbor's tree lighting and Grinch day (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Painesville

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Painesville and nearby Chardon, Concord Township and Fairport Harbor
  • 2 free events: Santa in the Square and the Concord Township tree lighting
  • Meet Santa: Santa in the Square (December 4 to 6 and 11 to 13), Santa and Mrs. Claus at the Chardon lighting (November 28) and at the Concord Township tree lighting (December 4), and photos with Santa and the Grinch in Fairport Harbor (December 5)
  • Lights: Painesville Holiday Lights on Painesville Square and Main Street (nightly to January 1) and tree lightings in Chardon, Concord Township and Fairport Harbor
  • Trains: none running in town this season; the nearest are the North Pole Adventure on the Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad and the North Pole Train Display at Lake Metroparks Farmpark in Kirtland
  • Season: November 28 to January 1
